coverage: All continuous anchors for every recorded source profile in the full usable stock, including the small margins excluded by the construction.
scope: Four brackets, two inserts and four cogs, with all bracket quarter-turn/mirror profiles, both rectangular insert orientations and the fixed recorded cog angle. This does not exclude other cog angles or other second-sheet part compositions.
proof: Every possible continuous vertical anchor is within14/1000mm of a covered original cell. Moving a polygon by that amount changes its area in any horizontal band by at most its bounding width times14/1000mm. The conservative integer losses above cover that change for every family/profile. Every cell therefore retains its family adjusted weighted lower bound. Summing the mandatory parts exceeds the weighted stock capacity by the positive exact integer margin shown.
